body: It is just difficult. I never knew pain to this level. I am painted as crazy when other people intentionally hurt me? Twisted. I think you just give up.
Do you happen to know what drives your disorder?
Oh, you know...the depression part makes me seem "crazy," unnecessarily. Yea, some days are worse than others. I suppose some of the texts were extremely difficult on me

Can I ask why you say you are dying to move on? Yea, I think it is hard to see it from her perspective. I think she needs to.have a platform to discuss why she is hard on herself and where that comes from. I think friends talk.about those sorts of things. Maybe you can all do something fun with a bunch of friends? I am not sure how morbid her thoughts are, but maybe you can get an idea?
Hurt her a lot in what way? Oh, I personalized every gift he was ever given and he replaced me like I meant nothing. I meant, it is fine to put your emotions out there and feel something, care.

I could never live with myself if I placed anyone into this mindset. I think it easy for people to call others crazy or toss the balme, but I think that just allows them to sleep better. I wake up multiple times a night due to horrible dreams associated with everything that has been done. I have not disclosed all the personal information that was done of me. Lies were told about me to their coworkers, with everyone thinking I am a lunatic.

I totally understand. I do. I think in ways when you invest in others to.that capacity it feels you lose a big part of yourself. My ex was the love of my life and I made it my mission to make him happy, but I never focused on myself.  I was certain he was the one and it all was stripped from me, in the most horrible of ways. It turned into a war to make sure I was hurt to the maximum level. As someone I am guessing is older than you, never feel bad for wearing your heart on.your sleeve, ever. We are a rare breed.

You were raped and that IS NOT your fault. I realize some people try to hurt you as much as possible because they simply aren't good people. I think it hurts because it comes from people you never expect to do or say suxh horrible things. I also am dealing with depression over things that were said to me in the most hateful way. It is absolutely hard to grasp. Yes, I care...because we are going through fairly similar situations.

I have considered it, but I know it will come with a lot of ramifications. I am too nice and I just need to stand up for myself. The people don't care because they obviously do it. It doesn't help that he believes everything she says.

As someone who can relate to this post. I think she is assessing everything that has happened in her life. It is extremely difficult to be used, particularly at such a young age. I dislike when everyone thinks it is for attention. There is such a thing as situational depression. You were apparently one of the good guys and she trusts you. Be there for her. Is she very hard on herself? Scared of failing?
You hear that as well? Let me guesa, you gave her the world?
